milestone.title: Autopilot tab: 40/60 split geometry + While-Executing full-screen takeover

intent.outcome: The Autopilot tab gains a control-first split view (setup-left 40%, sidebar tabs on the right 60%) and a dedicated While-Executing full-screen takeover that replaces the split when a run is live. Operators can configure a run and watch it progress on the same screen, with the State tab hidden during a run and a per-milestone peek view filling its gap.

problem.description: The current autopilot tab (crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot.rs, ~2,400 LOC) is a status-first view: it has no clickable buttons, no config form, no dedicated run dashboard. The 2026-09-26 audit pass surfaced ten user requirements from autopilot-draft/final-draft (M-questionnaire): (a) clickable chips with mouse + keyboard, (b) per-topology / per-harness / per-milestone setup form, (c) tabbed sidebar with Progress / Activity / State, (d) State tab hides during run; a dedicated run-mode screen takes over, (e) Pause / Stop / Resume control row always visible, (f) detached-mode confirmation pop on Detached click, (g) tooltip config drift detection, (h) topo id auto-derived from topology choice, (i) persistent .mp/autopilot-state.json reflecting user choices, (j) state inspector with read-only fields. The current code has none of these. A redrafted tab is the only way forward; this milestone scopes the geometry + run-mode changes, deferring the floating milestone picker to M242.

in_scope: Replace crates/raul/src/tui/render/autopilot.rs and lane_lists.rs::render_autopilot_tab with the new geometry: setup region (left, 40%) + tabbed sidebar (right, 60%).

Setup region: six stacked sections in order — (1) Topology radio chips, (2) Harness per role (uniform toggle + 3 rows of 3 chips + advanced override link), (3) Milestones chips row with [+ select] and [only-ready] buttons, (4) Commit policy 4 chips, (5) Run mode 2 chips (normal / detached), (6) large cyan Start button with a one-line summary ('3 milestones · ~12 min est.').
Control row directly below the Start button: ⏸ Pause / ⏹ Stop / ↻ Resume / ⤴ back, all dimmed when no live run.
Sidebar tabs (right side, 60%): Progress (default), Activity, State. Clicking a tab or pressing 1/2/3 switches.
State tab is hidden while a run is live; per-milestone peek view fills its gap during run.
While-Executing full-screen takeover replaces the entire split when a run is live. Five sections: topo strip / milestone lanes / activity / telemetry / control row.
Per-milestone peek view opens when clicking a row in While Executing (read-only intent + AC list + view reviews link).
Sidebar drag handler clamps the split-percent between 25% (min) and 75% (max). Below 25% the snap-back fires; above 75% the same. Drag is enabled only when no run is live.

Topo id (in the Advanced Override panel) is auto-derived from the chosen topology + a per-plan counter stored in .mp/autopilot-state.json::setup.topo_counter. Format: 'three-agent-001' for 3-agent, 'two-agent-001' for 2-agent, 'one-agent-001' for 1-agent.
Detached-mode confirmation popover every time the user clicks Detached (Q2 user choice). Three buttons: Confirm / Configure extras / Back.

Mouse Model B (free click + focus) — every chip / button / tab independently clickable. Mouse hit-test registry populated for setup row chips (~30 targets) + control row (4 targets) + sidebar tabs (3 targets) + per-milestone rows in While Executing.
250ms telemetry refresh worker (existing pattern from M216) kept; idle when no run is live.

.mp/autopilot-state.json writer/reader. Schema (v2): setup block (topology, harness_uniform, harness per role, milestones, commit_policy, run_mode, topo_counter) + ui block (sidebar_tab, picker_open, sidebar_visible, split_pct, while_executing_last_seen) + last_run block.

Keybinds additions: 1/2/3 = sidebar tabs, [ ] = cycle tabs, : = collapse sidebar, m = jump to milestones row, c = jump to commit policy, d = cycle run mode, r = dynamic (resume when running, run-mode toggle when idle), s = Start.
Keymap overlay (press ?) with full list of bindings, including the dynamic-r context-switch note.
Animation: status dot pulse at ~1Hz on active rows; sidebar tab transition fades ~150ms; both skippable on slow terminals (auto-detected via setup.dim-allowed).
out_of_scope: Floating milestone picker (M242 — same internal state, different milestone).
Recent-runs UI (deferred to a future milestone per Q5).
Mid-run 'Apply' edits (Pause+Edit returns to pre-fill but does not commit until Start is clicked again).
Per-window resize animations other than the sidebar tab fade.
A brand-new button widget library (we use ratatui's Block + a small focus state).

acceptance_criteria.description: Setup region renders correctly on a 132x36 terminal: six sections stacked vertically, each interactive; chips respond to click + keyboard.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/autopilot_setup_layout/)'; visual inspection of crates/raul/tests/fixtures/autopilot_setup_render.txt

acceptance_criteria.description: Sidebar drag handler clamps split-percent between 25% and 75%; outside range, snaps back; persisted to .mp/autopilot-state.json::ui.split_pct on debounce.
Sidebar tabs Progress / Activity / State switchable via mouse click and via keys 1/2/3; [ ] cycle; : collapse-toggles the sidebar visibility.
State tab renders read-only dump of session.json, override-panel.json, .mp/autopilot-state.json (versions + fields) with Refresh + Copy buttons; auto-refreshes every 250ms while active.

While-Executing takeover: when a run goes live, the split view disappears; full-screen takeover shows the topo strip, three milestone lanes (status + cycle + progress bar + est time left), an activity tail auto-sized to fill, telemetry strip, and the control row.
While a run is live, the State tab is hidden (mouse + key 3 do nothing); per-milestone peek view opens via click on any lane row in While Executing.

Topo id (in Advanced Override) is auto-derived and read-only: 'one-agent-001' / 'two-agent-001' / 'three-agent-001' per the current topology; counter increments per plan, persisted in .mp/autopilot-state.json::setup.topo_counter.
Detached-mode confirmation popover appears every time the Detached chip is clicked. Confirm carries through; Configure extras reveals the detached knobs; Back cancels.
.mp/autopilot-state.json (v2 schema) writes on every chip click + each cycle boundary + sidebar visibility change; read on every planner state read.
Keymap overlay (? or F1) renders the full key list including the dynamic-r context-switch note ('r: resume when running, run-mode when idle').

make lint + make test + consumer-surface-lint remain green; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0; no mp autopilot consumers break (the projection is purely additive — existing reads are unaffected).
acceptance_criteria.verification: make lint && make test && make consumer-surface-lint

work_packages.name: Geometry rewrite
work_packages.goal: Replace the render_autopilot_tab function with the new 40/60 split: setup region (left) + tabbed sidebar (right). Includes all six setup-row sections, control row, and the per-section chip + button widgets.
work_packages.rollback: Restore the original render_autopilot_tab from a tag; the new code is removed at the function level only.

work_packages.name: Sidebar tabs and drag
work_packages.goal: Sidebar with three tabs (Progress / Activity / State). Drag handles split-percent clamp 25%/75%. Tab switching via click + keys 1/2/3. Sidebar collapse-toggle via key :.
work_packages.rollback: Disable the drag; restore single-pane progress view; tabs are still clickable but no drag.

work_packages.name: While-Executing + State tab hide
work_packages.goal: Full-screen takeover while a run is live: 5 sections (topo strip / milestone lanes / activity / telemetry / controls). State tab hides during run. Per-milestone peek view replaces it.
work_packages.rollback: Revert to split view during run; the takeover is the new feature and can be conditional.

work_packages.name: State, keybinds, and persistence
work_packages.goal: .mp/autopilot-state.json schema v2 (setup + ui + last_run). Topo id auto-derive. Detached confirm. Keybinds registry updates. 250ms telemetry refresh.
work_packages.rollback: Revert state.json schema to v1; drop keybind additions; topology counter falls back to literal 'three-agent' string.

steps.action: Rewrite render_autopilot_tab to draw the 40/60 split. Setup region on the left (Topology, Harness per role, Milestones, Commit policy, Run mode, Start button + summary + control row). Mouse Model B + keymap wired.
Implement the split-percent drag handler. Clamp between 25% and 75%. Snap back if dragged outside; debounced persist to .mp/autopilot-state.json::ui.split_pct. Drag enabled only when no run is live.
Implement the State tab read-only dump (session.json, override-panel.json, .mp/autopilot-state.json). Auto-refresh at 250ms cadence when the State tab is the active tab. Refresh + Copy buttons.

Hide the State tab while a run is live (mouse and key 3 do nothing during run). Implement per-milestone peek view: click any milestone row in While Executing opens a read-only modal showing intent + AC list + view reviews link.
Implement the tabbed sidebar right side. Three tabs Progress default Activity State. Mouse click switches; keys 1 2 3 same; sidebar collapse-toggle via key ; and a small arrow icon.

Implement the While-Executing full-screen takeover function. Replace the entire split view when a run is live. Five sections: topo strip top, milestone lanes, activity tail auto-sized, telemetry strip, control row Pause Stop Resume Edit and re-run.

Implement the topo id auto-derive in the Advanced Override panel: one-agent-001 two-agent-001 three-agent-001 from the chosen topology + a per-plan counter stored in state.json setup.topo_counter. Field is read-only.
Implement the detached-mode confirmation popover: every click on Detached chip pops a Confirm Configure extras Back modal. Confirm carries through; Configure reveals detached knobs; Back cancels.

Wire S2.1 and S2.2 into the keymap resolver. This step becomes a placeholder for the orchestration only — the actual keymap registry additions live in S2.2 and the dynamic-r context-switch lives in S2.1.
Run make lint plus make test plus consumer-surface-lint plus cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; ensure no regressions.
steps.tests: make lint; make test; make consumer-surface-lint

steps.action: Implement the .mp/autopilot-state.json schema v2 reader/writer. Setup block topology harness_uniform harness per role milestones commit_policy run_mode topo_counter plus UI block plus last_run block. Write on every chip click plus each cycle boundary plus sidebar visibility change.
Implement the dynamic-r binding context-switch via view_state. r means resume when running; run-mode toggle when idle. Touches the resolver that picks the active handler for r.

Add the keymap registry additions for the autopilot tab: 1 2 3 for sidebar tabs; open and close brackets for tab cycle; colon for sidebar collapse; m jump to milestones row; c jump to commit policy; d cycle run mode. Wired into App::handle_key and view_state.
Build the keymap overlay (? or F1). Renders the full binding list as a centered Block with palette.accent border. Includes the dynamic-r context-switch note inline.
